data.name: CLI_Loading_ListFeatureValues
data.value:
"Loading values" in Swahili can be translated in a few ways, depending on the context:
* **"Inajaza thamani"** - This is a more literal translation and works well in general. * **"Inachaji thamani"** - This is also a good option and emphasizes the process of loading. * **"Data inaajiriwa"** - This option is more suitable when talking about loading data from a source. * **"Inajadili thamani"** - This option is suitable when talking about loading values from a database or other data source.
